description: This file contains the implementation of the NXP Ethernet MAC driver for Zephyr RTOS, including configuration structures, initialization routines, PHY management, interrupt handling, and data transmission/reception functions.

methods.name: get_iface
methods.description: Returns the appropriate network interface, considering VLAN tags.

methods.name: eth_get_ptp_data
methods.description: Determines if a packet contains PTP data and sets priority accordingly.

methods.name: ts_register_tx_event
methods.description: Registers timestamp data for transmitted frames.

methods.name: eth_wait_for_ptp_ts
methods.description: Waits for PTP timestamping to complete.

methods.name: eth_nxp_enet_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns hardware capabilities of the Ethernet device.

methods.name: eth_nxp_enet_set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters like MAC address.

methods.name: eth_nxp_enet_rx
methods.description: Receives Ethernet frames and processes them.

methods.name: eth_nxp_enet_get_ptp_clock
methods.description: Returns the associated PTP clock device.

methods.name: eth_callback
methods.description: Handles Ethernet hardware events such as RX/TX completion and errors.

methods.name: eth_nxp_enet_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for Ethernet events.

methods.name: nxp_enet_phy_init
methods.description: Initializes PHY device and sets link callback.

methods.name: nxp_enet_driver_cb
methods.description: Handles driver-specific callbacks for MDIO and PTP clock events.

methods.name: eth_nxp_enet_init
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet device, configures hardware, and starts threads.
